name: LCD_3V3_LINK_OPEN
note: Normally OPEN low-profile wire link. Close only after MCU LDO current/thermal checks; external J10 must be disconnected.

name: LCD_EXT_3V3_IN
note: Regulated 3.3V ONLY. JP3 must be OPEN. Power MCU/LCD together. Never connect 5V or parallel regulator outputs.

name: 100nF 50V P5.08
note: LCD rail bypass. External regulator must include its specified bulk/output capacitors; module already includes local decoupling.
